meta.decoy_rule: pool = the union of the run's suite label vocabularies (first-seen order); per slot: pool minus the slot's own labels, ranked by trigram-Jaccard to the GOLD label DESC, then K evenly-spaced picks across the ranked list (the linspace law: near→far graded, deterministic); decoys APPEND (originals keep positions); a pool smaller than K caps the arm (disclosed per suite).
meta.gate_rules: CONTROL gates (a red refuses the run): A2 — ZERO WITHIN-REGIME preference flips beyond exact reference ties (the engine's by-name route arms only while k ≤ N, so an arm past the domain count switches regimes BY DESIGN — those flips are the arming law, disclosed as cross-regime, never red); A3a — the paired noul readout BIT-identical across arms; A1-floor (Report-the-Floor, Plan 340 shape) — the DEPLOYED (cal-slice-calibrated) confidence's abstention AUROC/ECE must beat the conformal-naive floor over the raw max-prob on the cal/test split (≥1 axis better, none worse). A1's drift curve itself is CHARACTERIZED (the issue's own ⚠: max-of-K drift is the measured quantity), never gated on an unstudied ε. The Issue-092 2-feature candidate leg (σ(a·maxp + b·ent + c), fit on the same cal slice) is REPORT-ONLY: it never gates the run and never arms anything. Comparison-lane reds are disclosed rows.
meta.laya_note: laya not wired in this unit: the perm-probe seam discards the answer's confidence field and A1/A3 need it — the lane joins when its oracle exposes a confidence readout.
